en.confirmDetail:
Removing MixRelay Driver stops its devices and loopback and briefly interrupts system audio. Quit recording and call apps before continuing.

Saved MixRelay Driver settings are kept unless you choose to delete them.
en.settingsPreserved: Saved MixRelay Driver settings were kept.
en.settingsDeleted: Saved MixRelay Driver settings were also deleted.
en.linuxDriverMessage: Removes the virtual devices and service of MixRelay Driver and briefly interrupts system audio.
en.settingsWillBePreserved: Saved MixRelay Driver settings will be kept.
en.settingsWillBeDeleted: Saved MixRelay Driver settings will also be deleted.
en.authorization: Administrator authorization or the request to the MixRelay Driver removal helper failed. Try again and approve administrator authorization if prompted. If the problem continues, contact support@mixrelay.com.

ko.confirmDetail:
MixRelay Driver 장치와 루프백이 중지되며 시스템 오디오가 잠시 끊깁니다. 계속하기 전에 녹음과 통화 앱을 종료하십시오.

저장된 MixRelay Driver 설정은 삭제 옵션을 선택하지 않으면 보존합니다.
ko.linuxDriverMessage: MixRelay Driver의 가상 장치와 서비스를 제거하며 시스템 오디오가 잠시 끊깁니다.
ko.authorization: 관리자 인증 또는 MixRelay Driver 제거 도우미 요청에 실패했습니다. 다시 시도하고 관리자 인증 요청이 표시되면 승인하십시오. 문제가 계속되면 support@mixrelay.com으로 문의하십시오.

ja.confirmDetail:
MixRelay Driverを削除すると、デバイスとループバックが停止し、システム音声が一時的に中断します。続行する前に録音・通話アプリを終了してください。

削除オプションを選択しない限り、MixRelay Driverの保存済み設定は保持されます。
ja.settingsPreserved: MixRelay Driverの保存済み設定は保持されました。
ja.settingsDeleted: MixRelay Driverの保存済み設定も削除されました。
ja.linuxDriverMessage: MixRelay Driverの仮想デバイスとサービスを削除し、システム音声を一時的に中断します。
ja.settingsWillBePreserved: MixRelay Driverの保存済み設定は保持されます。
ja.settingsWillBeDeleted: MixRelay Driverの保存済み設定も削除されます。
ja.authorization: 管理者認証、またはMixRelay Driver削除ヘルパーへの要求に失敗しました。再試行し、管理者認証を求められたら承認してください。問題が続く場合はsupport@mixrelay.comへお問い合わせください。
ja.working: MixRelay Driverを削除しています…

zh-Hans.confirmDetail:
移除 MixRelay Driver 将停止其设备和回环，并暂时中断系统音频。继续之前，请退出录音和通话应用。

除非您选择删除设置，否则将保留已保存的 MixRelay Driver 设置。
zh-Hans.settingsPreserved: 已保留保存的 MixRelay Driver 设置。
zh-Hans.settingsDeleted: 已同时删除保存的 MixRelay Driver 设置。
zh-Hans.linuxDriverMessage: 移除 MixRelay Driver 的虚拟设备和服务，并暂时中断系统音频。
zh-Hans.settingsWillBePreserved: 将保留已保存的 MixRelay Driver 设置。
zh-Hans.settingsWillBeDeleted: 还将删除已保存的 MixRelay Driver 设置。
zh-Hans.authorization: 管理员授权或向 MixRelay Driver 移除辅助程序发出的请求失败。请重试，并在出现管理员授权提示时批准。如果问题持续，请联系 support@mixrelay.com。

zh-Hant.confirmDetail:
移除 MixRelay Driver 將停止其裝置和回送，並暫時中斷系統音訊。繼續之前，請結束錄音及通話應用程式。

除非您選擇刪除設定，否則將保留已儲存的 MixRelay Driver 設定。
zh-Hant.settingsPreserved: 已保留儲存的 MixRelay Driver 設定。
zh-Hant.settingsDeleted: 已同時刪除儲存的 MixRelay Driver 設定。
zh-Hant.linuxDriverMessage: 移除 MixRelay Driver 的虛擬裝置與服務，並暫時中斷系統音訊。
zh-Hant.settingsWillBePreserved: 將保留已儲存的 MixRelay Driver 設定。
zh-Hant.settingsWillBeDeleted: 也將刪除已儲存的 MixRelay Driver 設定。
zh-Hant.authorization: 管理員授權或向 MixRelay Driver 移除輔助程式提出的請求失敗。請重試，並在出現管理員授權提示時核准。如果問題持續，請聯絡 support@mixrelay.com。

fr.confirmDetail:
La suppression de MixRelay Driver arrête ses périphériques et son bouclage audio, et interrompt brièvement l’audio du système. Fermez les applications d’enregistrement et d’appel avant de continuer.

Les réglages enregistrés de MixRelay Driver sont conservés, sauf si vous choisissez de les supprimer.
fr.settingsPreserved: Les réglages enregistrés de MixRelay Driver ont été conservés.
fr.settingsDeleted: Les réglages enregistrés de MixRelay Driver ont également été supprimés.
fr.linuxDriverMessage: Supprime les périphériques virtuels et le service de MixRelay Driver, et interrompt brièvement l’audio du système.
fr.settingsWillBePreserved: Les réglages enregistrés de MixRelay Driver seront conservés.
fr.settingsWillBeDeleted: Les réglages enregistrés de MixRelay Driver seront également supprimés.
fr.authorization: L’autorisation administrateur ou la demande envoyée à l’outil auxiliaire de suppression de MixRelay Driver a échoué. Réessayez et approuvez l’autorisation administrateur si elle vous est demandée. Si le problème persiste, contactez support@mixrelay.com.
fr.working: Suppression de MixRelay Driver en cours…

de.confirmDetail:
Das Entfernen von MixRelay Driver beendet seine Geräte und das Loopback und unterbricht kurz das Systemaudio. Beenden Sie Aufnahme- und Anruf-Apps, bevor Sie fortfahren.

Die gespeicherten Einstellungen von MixRelay Driver bleiben erhalten, sofern Sie nicht deren Löschung auswählen.
de.settingsPreserved: Die gespeicherten Einstellungen von MixRelay Driver wurden beibehalten.
de.settingsDeleted: Die gespeicherten Einstellungen von MixRelay Driver wurden ebenfalls gelöscht.
de.linuxDriverMessage: Entfernt die virtuellen Geräte und den Dienst von MixRelay Driver und unterbricht kurz das Systemaudio.
de.settingsWillBePreserved: Die gespeicherten Einstellungen von MixRelay Driver bleiben bei der Entfernung erhalten.
de.settingsWillBeDeleted: Die gespeicherten Einstellungen von MixRelay Driver werden bei der Entfernung ebenfalls gelöscht.
de.authorization: Die Administratorautorisierung oder die Anfrage an das Hilfsprogramm zum Entfernen von MixRelay Driver ist fehlgeschlagen. Versuchen Sie es erneut und erteilen Sie die Administratorautorisierung, falls Sie dazu aufgefordert werden. Wenn das Problem weiterhin besteht, wenden Sie sich an support@mixrelay.com.

es.confirmDetail:
Eliminar MixRelay Driver detiene sus dispositivos y el bucle de audio e interrumpe brevemente el audio del sistema. Cierre las aplicaciones de grabación y llamadas antes de continuar.

La configuración guardada de MixRelay Driver se conserva, salvo que elija eliminarla.
es.settingsPreserved: Se ha conservado la configuración guardada de MixRelay Driver.
es.settingsDeleted: También se ha eliminado la configuración guardada de MixRelay Driver.
es.linuxDriverMessage: Elimina los dispositivos virtuales y el servicio de MixRelay Driver e interrumpe brevemente el audio del sistema.
es.settingsWillBePreserved: Se conservará la configuración guardada de MixRelay Driver.
es.settingsWillBeDeleted: También se eliminará la configuración guardada de MixRelay Driver.
es.authorization: La autorización del administrador o la solicitud enviada a la herramienta auxiliar para eliminar MixRelay Driver falló. Vuelva a intentarlo y apruebe la autorización del administrador si se le solicita. Si el problema continúa, contacte con support@mixrelay.com.

pt.confirmDetail:
A remoção do MixRelay Driver interrompe seus dispositivos e o loopback, além de interromper brevemente o áudio do sistema. Feche os aplicativos de gravação e chamadas antes de continuar.

As configurações salvas do MixRelay Driver são mantidas, a menos que você escolha excluí-las.
pt.settingsPreserved: As configurações salvas do MixRelay Driver foram mantidas.
pt.settingsDeleted: As configurações salvas do MixRelay Driver também foram excluídas.
pt.linuxDriverMessage: Remove os dispositivos virtuais e o serviço do MixRelay Driver e interrompe brevemente o áudio do sistema.
pt.settingsWillBePreserved: As configurações salvas do MixRelay Driver serão mantidas.
pt.settingsWillBeDeleted: As configurações salvas do MixRelay Driver também serão excluídas.
pt.authorization: A autorização do administrador ou a solicitação enviada à ferramenta auxiliar de remoção do MixRelay Driver falhou. Tente novamente e aprove a autorização do administrador se ela for solicitada. Se o problema continuar, entre em contato com support@mixrelay.com.

it.confirmDetail:
La rimozione di MixRelay Driver arresta i dispositivi e il loopback e interrompe brevemente l’audio del sistema. Chiudete le app di registrazione e chiamata prima di continuare.

Le impostazioni salvate di MixRelay Driver vengono conservate, a meno che non scegliate di eliminarle.
it.settingsPreserved: Le impostazioni salvate di MixRelay Driver sono state conservate.
it.settingsDeleted: Anche le impostazioni salvate di MixRelay Driver sono state eliminate.
it.linuxDriverMessage: Rimuove i dispositivi virtuali e il servizio di MixRelay Driver e interrompe brevemente l’audio del sistema.
it.settingsWillBePreserved: Le impostazioni salvate di MixRelay Driver saranno conservate.
it.settingsWillBeDeleted: Anche le impostazioni salvate di MixRelay Driver saranno eliminate.
it.authorization: L’autorizzazione amministratore o la richiesta all’assistente di rimozione di MixRelay Driver non è riuscita. Riprovate e approvate l’autorizzazione amministratore, se richiesta. Se il problema persiste, contattate support@mixrelay.com.
it.working: Rimozione di MixRelay Driver in corso…

ru.confirmDetail:
Удаление MixRelay Driver остановит его устройства и loopback и ненадолго прервёт системный звук. Перед продолжением закройте приложения записи и звонков.

Сохранённые настройки MixRelay Driver останутся, если вы не выберете их удаление.
ru.settingsDeleted: Сохранённые настройки MixRelay Driver также удалены.
ru.linuxDriverMessage: Удаляет виртуальные устройства и службу MixRelay Driver и ненадолго прерывает системный звук.
ru.settingsWillBeDeleted: Сохранённые настройки MixRelay Driver также будут удалены.
ru.authorization: Не удалось получить разрешение администратора или выполнить запрос к вспомогательной программе удаления MixRelay Driver. Повторите попытку и, если появится запрос разрешения администратора, подтвердите его. Если проблема повторяется, обратитесь по адресу support@mixrelay.com.
